kind_of_thing.quote: The tiger (Panthera tigris) is a large cat and a member of the genus Panthera native to Asia.

kind_of_animal.quote: The tiger (Panthera tigris) is the largest living member of the cat family, the Felidae.

extinct.quote: It is listed as Endangered on the IUCN Red List of Threatened Species, as its range is thought to have declined by 53% to 68% since the late 1990s.
